messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore presents scientific evidence on climate change, its impacts, and policy solutions. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to witness the effects of climate change and discusses ways to mitigate it. |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A global environmental documentary featuring voices from science, business, and faith communities, focusing on the urgent need to address climate change. |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A concise, data‑driven overview of the science behind global warming and its socioeconomic consequences. |
| **“Our Planet” (Season 1)** | 2019 | While primarily a nature series, each episode highlights how climate change threatens ecosystems and wildlife. |

If you’d like more details on any of these or want recommendations tailored to a specific region or aspect of climate change, just let me know!
